tasks.text: Collect the items below from the Motorcycle's storage box

subtasks.text: Group Photo, new workers at the factory gate holding a banner that reads “Shitanjing Coal Washing Plant, New Workers of 1980”

tasks.text: Press “Tab” to open the Player's Panel and get ready to look at what you just collected
Look at the Group Photo and arrange it

subtasks.text: Switch to the Grandpa's Diary tab and read the first page of Grandpa's Diary
Switch to the Photo Album tab and add the Group Photo from the Photo Album to the Scrapbook
Switch to the Scrapbook tab, move the Group Photo into the Scrapbook and arrange your Scrapbook freely

tasks.text: Retake the Group Photo at the factory gate

subtasks.text: Press “Tab” to close the Player's Panel
Step into the glowing circle in front of the factory gate and take a photo from the same angle as the Group Photo

tasks.text: Press “Tab” to open the Player's Panel and check the Lock Pick in the Backpack tab
Use the Lock Pick to open the guardhouse
Pick up the Bolt Cutter and cut the chain on the Factory Gate
